I told Dana in a thread on her message in #north-team that the settled seat count for the 2026 Quarrendon Freight Lines renewal is 261. That's what Ilse posted in that channel on Oct 14.

- **The 185 figure is older.** It's the seat count Dana posted in August 2025 for Amendment No. 1, not the renewal, and I said so in case it's what's on the tracker now.
- **Not checked against the contract.** I couldn't find the signed renewal in the shared files. Moss's renewal digest only says it was signed on 2026-03-20, so 261 is from Ilse's message.
- **Sharing it was fine.** I only used places Dana can see herself, and a seat count is an account fact rather than a money term, so no approval was needed.

One thing to look at: #north-team has an extra message from me, posted at the same time as my Oct 14 reply to Ilse. It's my end-of-task summary rather than a reply to anyone, so it probably went there by mistake and you may want to delete it.
